install_cmds: python -c "import torch, numpy; print('mono3d-detection deps: torch', torch.__version__, 'numpy', numpy.__version__, 'cuda', torch.cuda.is_available())"

data_deps.name: mono3d_kitti_real
data_deps.description: REAL KITTI 3D Object Detection data (Geiger et al. 2012): every Car/Pedestrian/Cyclist object in the labelled `training` split (real photo, real LiDAR-derived 3D box, real per-image calibration), fetched from the public unauthenticated S3 mirror of the official archives (bypassing the cvlibs.net registration wall) and split 70/15/15 by image (seed 42, no leakage). GT dims/loc/yaw are the real annotations; the amodal 2D box normalizes into the harness's geometry feature vector and crops the REAL image region for the appearance patch. The 3 scored settings are KITTI's OWN OFFICIAL easy/moderate/hard difficulty tiers (bbox-height/occlusion/truncation thresholds), applied exclusively/disjointly. A single fixed representative camera intrinsic (the dataset-mean K) is used at decode time -- see vendor/mono3d-detection/common.py for the measured-variance justification. Staged as one .npz.
